summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive coverage of core logic (glob matching, rule application, priority resolution, group conflicts), file loading, CLI output contract, and workflow structure. Validates actionlint compliance. Edge cases in priority ordering (negative/very large values), special characters in patterns/labels, and empty config are undertested. CLI tests have minor sequential dependencies. act-runner.ts is well-designed for end-to-end pipeline validation but fixture definitions are not shown, so integration test quality cannot be assessed. Would catch most regressions in implemented functionality.
